R3B-bear-atv-0001.name: By Miledge Creek
R3B-bear-atv-0001.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R3B-bear-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (3000); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2018 (8 years old), 460 m W: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2018 (fire G32617), 380 m NW: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
S facing slope, 35 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Miledge Creek 90 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).

plan: Drive: from Blue River, about 30 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5.
Park: 52.29964, -119.18333, where the truck road ends (3000); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.3 km on 3000 by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 310 m SW, climb about 0 m.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-44, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
